caption:
FHA loans are getting new score options. 🏠

FHA says it will accept VantageScore 4.0 and FICO Score 10T for loans with case numbers assigned on or after Jan 1, 2027.

FHA policy stays as it is until formal updates are published.

Would you want to know which score your lender uses?
first_comment: Did you know different lenders can look at different scores? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Which score do you check most? Tell us at @creditscoretruths 👇

card.headline: FHA will accept 2 new score models from Jan 2027.
card.sub: VantageScore 4.0 and FICO 10T. Current policy holds until then.
